title: Chapter 34 The Deserted City Is Willing To Fight Against The Evil Demons
content:
Chapter 34 The Deserted City Is Willing To Fight Against The Evil Demons

"Dad, is it over?"

In the mansion of the Lord of the Deserted City, Lu Xue looked at the starry sky and asked immediately.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I guess so."

Looking up at the starry sky, Lu Daosheng slowly stood up.

"Let's go, another guest is coming."

"Guest?"

Lu Xue was confused, but Lu Daosheng had already walked away. Seeing this, Lu Xue pouted and trotted after him.

"Dad, wait for me!"

......

In front of the gate of the Deserted City.

Duan Heng looked at the magnificent and domineering giant city in front of him, his mouth opened so wide that he could swallow an egg directly.

Originally, he could enter the Deserted City directly without going through the city gate.

The Deserted Guards and others had this privilege.

But when Duan Heng saw this giant city in the void, he was so shocked that he couldn't help himself and strongly demanded that he must go through the city gate.

This was a respect for this giant city.

At this time, Duan Heng looked up at the plaque above the city gate.

The two characters "Huangcheng" were written on it.

For a moment, Duan Heng seemed to be in an endless abyss, making it impossible for him to escape.

Bang!

Duan Heng collapsed on the ground.

When he woke up, he was already sweating all over, and everyone around him was looking at him. Only Ouyang Yanqing supported him.

Suddenly, Duan Heng's old face turned red, knowing that he had made a fool of himself, and he quickly got up.

"Why didn't you remind me?"

Duan Heng said to Ouyang Yanqing in a low voice with a little complaint.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing was also a little aggrieved.

"I, I don't know either."

She came directly to Huangcheng with Lu Daosheng, and she has never gone out since she came in. How could she know that there was such a terrifying plaque on the city gate.

Fortunately, she didn't see it just now.

"Brother Duan, let's go."

At this time, Huang Shou said with a smile.

Hearing this, Duan Heng coughed lightly, "Okay, let's go."

Then, everyone entered Huangcheng directly.

"This, "

As soon as he entered the deserted city, Duan Heng was shocked again.

He actually felt a long-lost feeling, which was a sign of loosening of his realm.

Holy land! The real holy land! !

That's right, under the influence of countless heaven-defying divine objects in the city lord's mansion, the entire deserted city has been completely transformed. Looking at the entire Hongmeng universe, there is no place more suitable for cultivation than here.

No wonder countless people from the outside world are trying their best to enter the deserted city.

It's a pity that things are different now.

The entrance fee is no longer as simple as one million spirit stones back then.

And the housing prices in the city have been driven up to sky-high prices.

The first batch of people who entered the city back then are now making a lot of money and are rich.

Especially Ji Shengcai, now in the city, everyone who sees him can't help but call him Master Ji.

"Yan Qing, is the city lord of this city really your friend?"

At this time, Duan Heng asked dully.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing hesitated a little, thinking of all the things between him and Lu Daosheng.

Uh, it seems like nothing.

"Well, I guess so."

Hearing this ambiguous answer, Duan Heng shook his head.

The other party's existence might not look down on his apprentice at all.

Then, Duan Heng continued to go to the City Lord's Mansion.

Along the way, countless people saluted Yunqi and the others, and only An Xing was unrecognized.

The prosperous scene in Huangcheng refreshed Duan Heng's cognition countless times.

There were many masters in the whole city.

Although there was no second strong man like him except Huang Shou, in such an environment, it was only a matter of time for a strong man in the realm of cause and effect to appear.

Thinking of time, Duan Heng was worried again.

I hope the owner of this city will not let him down.

Soon, everyone passed through layers of restrictions and finally returned to the City Lord's Mansion.

In the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion.

Duan Heng took a deep breath and stepped in.

As soon as he entered the hall, he felt like he was in the starry sky. The whole hall was filled with a mysterious atmosphere.

In the depths of the hall, a man with extraordinary temperament slowly emerged.

Seeing this scene, Duan Heng's respectful expression was beyond words.

He could not see through the other party at all.

A real strong man.

Moreover, he felt a more terrifying aura than Yang Lao in the man in front of him.

"I greet the Lord of the City."

"Lord of the City, we have fulfilled our mission. We have killed all the enemies."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded with satisfaction.

"Well done."

At this time, Duan Heng also saluted respectfully.

"I am the former Lord of the Eternal Temple, Duan Heng."

"Lord of the Deserted City, Lu Daosheng."

Lu Daosheng replied politely.

On the side, Ouyang Yanqing just watched without saying anything.

For some reason, she was a little afraid to speak when she saw Lu Daosheng today.

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared beside Ouyang Yanqing.

"Sister Ouyang."

"Hmm? Xiaoxue."

Seeing Lu Xue, Ouyang Yanqing immediately smiled.

Then, Ouyang Yanqing was pulled aside by Lu Xue.

"Lord Lu, thank you for taking care of Yanqing these days."

At this time, Duan Heng said.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's just a small matter."

Hearing this, Duan Heng hesitated.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng said, "Daoyou, you can say whatever you want."

Suddenly, Duan Heng's face lit up.

"Lord Lu, since you have said so, I will not keep you in suspense. Lord Lu, do you know the evil demon clan?"

Evil demon clan!

Suddenly, Gu Chen beside Duan Heng trembled.

Lu Daosheng also reacted.

Evil demon clan, the clan that he killed in the Evil God Abyss.

Of course, there is more than that. In the ancient times, there was a cosmic war. That war was the Hongmeng Universe against the evil demon clan.

All these are known in ancient books.

It's just that the records are not very detailed.

"Go on."

Then, Duan Heng continued: "Lord Lu, now, the evil demon clan is about to break through the cosmic barrier and invade my Hongmeng Universe again. At that time, the entire universe will fall into a place of no return."

"So, I would like to ask you to help the Hongmeng Universe."

Hearing this, the whole hall suddenly became a little boiling.

At the top, Lu Daosheng was silent.

That is to say, those evil demons will soon descend on the Hongmeng Universe again.

Then, Lu Daosheng looked up and swept his eyes over Yunqi, Gu Chen and the others.

"What are your plans?"

Yunqi was the first to step forward and said, "Lord City Lord, the aliens should be killed!"

Ah Wei clenched the long sword at his waist, "I am willing to contribute to the Hongmeng Universe."

Huang Shou touched the long sword in his hand and said slowly, "A real man is born in troubled times, and he should hold the sword in his hand to achieve unparalleled merits."

Gu Chen looked resolute, "Hongmeng Universe is in trouble, and we, as people of Hongmeng Universe, should contribute."

An Xing smiled and said, "Lord City Lord, the subordinates are the same."

Hearing the answers of his subordinates, Lu Daosheng was extremely satisfied.

"In this case, my Huangcheng will also fight against the evil demons."

Hearing this, Duan Heng's eyes were already red.

Then, Duan Heng bowed deeply to everyone.

"I, Duan Heng, on behalf of the Hongmeng Universe, would like to thank you all first."

"Senior Duan is too serious. We are all from the Hongmeng Universe."

Hearing this, Duan Heng smiled.

With the addition of such a powerful force, their chances of winning are even greater.

Then Duan Heng said goodbye.

He declined everyone's requests to stay and resolutely stepped towards the direction of the universe boundary.

And Lu Daosheng also promised that once the evil demons invaded, he would rush to the scene in the first place in the deserted city.

However, although Duan Heng left, Ouyang Yanqing still stayed in the deserted city.

In the starry sky, the Eternal Temple received Ouyang Yanqing's order and then ran back to the Eternal Galaxy in disgrace.

"Dad, will you take action at that time?"

In the hall, Lu Xue asked curiously.

Since the change of the deserted city, she seemed to have never seen her father take action.

All foreign enemies were solved by the men trained by her father.

Hearing this, everyone in the hall also looked at Lu Daosheng.

Yes, won't the Lord of the City take action?

Looking at the hopeful eyes of the people below, Lu Daosheng was silent.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng slowly said: "If you can't solve it, I will naturally take action."

If he takes action directly, I'm afraid that the rest of the people will have nothing to do.

He doesn't want this.

Hearing this, everyone immediately put their minds at ease.

Because in this way, the Hongmeng Universe must be worry-free.

In their hearts, Lu Daosheng is already an invincible existence.

And in fact, Lu Daosheng is indeed invincible.

"Lord of the City, give me tens of millions of troops, and I will kill the evil demon!"

At this time, Yunqi stepped forward.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's mouth twitched slightly.

Tens of millions of troops, it's easy for you to say.

Although I can indeed do it, the quality of the result will not be too high in such a short time.

According to what he had just deduced, the evil demon clan will completely break through the boundary barrier of the universe and directly invade the Hongmeng universe in a hundred years.

A hundred years is enough time for him to prepare.

Then, Lu Daosheng swept around the system store and handed Yunqi a storage ring.

"The resources inside are enough for you to build an army of one million."

Yunqi took the storage ring and breathed quickly.

After a rough glance, he found that there seemed to be one million top-grade treasures in it.

One million top-grade treasures.

What is that concept.

When he led his troops to fight, he only held a Taoist weapon in his hand.

(First to ninth grade, holy weapon, quasi-emperor weapon, emperor weapon, Taoist weapon, extreme emperor weapon, treasure weapon, top-grade treasure weapon,,)

And at that time, he was in the ancient realm.

But now, the city lord actually gave him a million top-grade treasures directly. For a moment, he seemed to be a bumpkin who had never seen the world.
